meta.title: Afterpage: Keep everything important in one place
meta.description: Afterpage is a home for the documents you don't want to lose. Scan, import, or share things in, and find them again instantly. Free to start, no account needed.

hero.title: Keep everything important in one place.
hero.subtitle: Afterpage is a home for the documents you don't want to lose, organized the way you think about them.
hero.trust: No account needed. Your documents stay in your own iCloud.

personalize.title: Personalize your space
personalize.subtitle: Custom icons, backgrounds, and more for your tags, categories, and contacts.
personalize.imageAlt: Custom tag and category icons, colors, and backgrounds in Afterpage

organize.title: Organize your way
organize.subtitle: Tags, categories, and contacts keep files easy to find.

bullets.title: Make it yours
bullets.body: Give any tag, category, or contact a name, a color, and an icon. Afterpage doesn't get in the way of your system.

bullets.title: Recents to the front
bullets.body: The tags and categories you use most often always float to the top so an active trip or frequent contact is always right there.

find.title: Find your stuff fast
find.subtitle: Search from anywhere in the app to get to what you need.
find.body: Afterpage uses on-device OCR and natural language tools to turn search into your superpower. Find your documents by what's inside them, not just the filename or tags you use (though that works, too).

bullets.title: Find from anywhere
bullets.body: Open a tag or category and search just inside it. Every collection has an intelligent search you can use to get to stuff faster.

bullets.title: A smarter search
bullets.body: Search uses advanced algorithms to show you the most relevant results. The most recent relevant documents will always be right up at the top.

capture.title: Import from (almost) everywhere
capture.body: Any PDF or image can be imported into Afterpage, and you can use the document scanner in-app to import documents quickly.

bullets.title: Scan
bullets.body: The built-in scanner handles edge detection, perspective correction, and multi-page capture, then stitches everything into one PDF.

bullets.title: Import
bullets.body: Pull a PDF or image straight from Files, one at a time or a whole batch at once.

bullets.title: Share it in
bullets.body: Send a file from Mail, Safari, Photos, or anywhere else on iOS with a share sheet, without leaving the app you're in.

siri.title: Plays well with Siri
siri.subtitle: Find documents by name, date, tag, or contact, out loud.
siri.body: "Find documents in Afterpage tagged Vet" or "…from Maple Grove Veterinary Clinic" surfaces a visual card with matching thumbnails and an Open in Afterpage button, right from Siri or a Shortcuts automation.

privacy.title: No accounts or external cloud services ever.
privacy.subtitle: Afterpage uses Apple's secure and private iCloud service to store and sync your data.

bullets.title: No sign-up needed
bullets.body: There's no sign-in, no username, no password anywhere in the app.

bullets.title: Your iCloud, not our servers
bullets.body: Documents sync through your iCloud Drive, and tags and titles sync through a private CloudKit database tied to your account. Afterpage doesn't run a server that stores your documents, and can never access any of your data.

pricing.title: Free to start, simple to grow into
pricing.subtitle: Scanning, OCR, and search are free for good. Pro adds the personalization on top.

features: Scan and import as many documents as you need
Sync across your iPhone and iPad with iCloud
Custom icons for your tags and categories
Custom background images, like a photo from the trip behind Disney World 2026
New personalization and smart features as they ship

faq.question: Do I need to create an account?
faq.answer: No. Afterpage identifies you through the iCloud account already signed into your device, the same way Files or Photos does. There's no sign-in screen anywhere in the app.

faq.question: Where do my documents actually live?
faq.answer: In your own iCloud Drive. Afterpage doesn't run a server that stores your documents, and there's nothing shared or public about your library.

faq.question: Does Afterpage use AI to read my documents?
faq.answer: It uses on-device Apple Intelligence to suggest a cleaner title after a document comes in, turning "Scan_0043" into something like "Comcast Bill – March 2026." It doesn't file or tag anything for you, and it only runs on devices where Apple Intelligence is available.

faq.question: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
faq.answer: Scanning, OCR, full-text search, and iCloud sync are free without limits. Pro adds custom icons and background images for your tags and categories, plus new personalization features as they roll out.

faq.question: What devices does it work on?
faq.answer: iPhone and iPad, kept in sync through your iCloud account.

boilerplate.title: Boilerplate
boilerplate.short: Afterpage is a document scanner for iPhone and iPad that turns receipts, bills, and contracts into a searchable archive, stored in your own iCloud.
boilerplate.long: Most scanner apps stop once a page is captured and leave the organizing to you. Afterpage does the opposite: an inbox workflow, tags and categories you set up yourself, and on-device OCR make every document searchable by what's actually written on it. There's no account to create and no server holding your files. Everything runs on your device and syncs through your own iCloud Drive.

brand.title: Brand
brand.voice: Warm and plainspoken. Afterpage talks about documents the way a person would, not the way a corporation would.

founder.title: Founder
founder.name: Mike Douglas
founder.body: Mike Douglas built Afterpage as an indie project after more than a decade building products at Dropbox, InVision, and AWS. He managed Dropbox Paper and later Dropbox Dash, worked on InVision's document organization and permissions systems, and ran an operations team for Amazon EFS. Afterpage grew out of a habit he never broke: building the software he wished existed for keeping his own paperwork in order.
